name.description: Display name for the queue (must be unique)

collection.description: Collection name for record subjects. Required if subjectTypes includes 'record'.

recommendedPolicies.description: Policy keys to recommend when actioning reports in this queue

errors.name: InvalidRecommendedPolicies
errors.description: One or more recommended policy keys do not exist in the configured policy list

errors.name: ConflictingQueue
errors.description: The queue configuration conflicts with an existing queue

main.description: Create a new moderation queue. A queue can have optional matching criteria that ozone's queue router will use to match reports. A queue with no criteria must have reports assigned to it manually via (1) `modTool.meta.queueId` in `tools.ozone.moderation.emitEvent` or (2) `tools.ozone.report.reassignQueue`.
